commitResults.messageBody:

relevant to Tutoria than with AB3.
Update Site Settings and part of the DG

The user presently can only find contacts by name and not details.

This is not helpful since tutors may remark students with "deficient in
math" or "monitor closely" and want to find those particular students,
hence needing a way to search all of a contact's aattributes.

Let's add a Search command that will go through all of the present
attributes in a Person class (Name, Address, Email, Tags and Phone) by
making similar classes to the Find command, and making a predicate that
checks all attributes.

This serves as a stepping stone by seeing what is possible at the app's
base stage, and will allow the user to find contacts based on any
attribute.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Search highlighting and update the UG
commitResults.messageBody:
While the code could search for each Person, it did not show which text
it matched with the given keyword, making it difficult for the user to
know why a search result turned up at first glance. The user guide also
does not reflect any searching functionality.

This can make searching difficult, and the user experience worse.

Let's modify the fxml parts of Person, along with PersonCard and
PersonListPanel, to incorporate highlighting functionaltiy, where it
uses the indexes of the found keywords and uses appropriate css to alter
its color to appear highlighted.

This will ensure users are able to easily see their keywords within
search results.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add initial undo and redo functionality
commitResults.messageBody:
Some commands are difficult or long to execute, and if users mistype
something it takes a lot of effort to undo their changes.

This can lead to some dissatisfaction.

Let's add undo and redo functionality so users can seemlessly undo their
commands if needed, and if they still require it, redo whatever they
undid.

This ensures users won't have to type every command out again and
enables them to work faster with a CLI.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix issue where students don't link after editing
commitResults.messageBody:
When student attributes are edited, the present way parents detect
students as "Name | number" will fail to update to the new name.

This results in the "Linked student" field in ParentContactCard to
become "N/A" if student names or numbers are ever edited. Furthermore,
searching for "1" could show a parent due to the linkedStudentId having
a "1" in "Name | 1234" which isn't what is shown on the
ParentContactCard.

Let's switch the id from "Name | number" to the actual randomized
student ID, and update any code that required "Name | Number" to rectify
the above issues, including saving and retrieving from files, the search
command, and tests.

Since the ID is meant to be immutable, any changes to students must
require that it be passed on, ensuring that the parent will always have
a reference to the same student regardless of changes in attributes.
Fix issue where students don't link after editing

After using search, some commands will not display the changes made
since the search is still in effect.

This is caused by parent list and the filtered person list in the model
manager still being filtered even after the search command is over.

Let's make logic manager reset the filtered lists at the end of every
command's execution if the command is not search. This way, commands
still act on the filtered list (i.e. after "search John" results in a
student John Tan in index 2 on the displayed list, "edit 2..." will edit
John Tan, and not the actual person in index 2 of the actual list in the
address book) to preserve the functionaltiy of every other command. Also
update tests to ensure this, as some tests assume that the list remains
filtered after executing commands other than search.

This ensures that every command will refresh the student and parent list
to remove any ambiguity caused by searching.
